lines.text: To answer "how fast", the robot works out three speeds and picks the smallest.
One: its top speed, four meters per second.

Two: the fastest speed it can still stop from in the distance left. From four meters per second, stopping takes one point three meters. It even brakes a twentieth of a second early, to cover its own reaction time.
Three: near the end, slow down gently, in a straight line, so it doesn't wobble.
Smallest of the three, every loop. And inside three millimeters, it just stops.
